nodes.description: Context._msgSender(): internal view returning msg.sender, the origin of caller identity for the token.
Ownable.owner(): returns the stored privileged _owner address.
KingBobo.transfer(address,uint256): public ERC20 transfer that forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
KingBobo.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): public transfer that deducts allowance and calls _transfer.
KingBobo._transfer: private core routing logic performing limits, fee collection, reflection balance updates and swap trigger.
KingBobo.collectFee(address,uint256,uint256): private fee engine deducting tax, liquidity and burn fees from a transfer amount.
KingBobo._getReflectionRate(): private view computing the reflection-to-token conversion rate over excluded accounts.
KingBobo.swapAndLiquify(uint256): private lockTheSwap routine swapping accumulated tokens for ETH and forwarding ETH to the liquidity wallet.
KingBobo.swapTokensForEth(uint256): private helper calling the Uniswap router to swap tokens for ETH.
KingBobo.excludeAccount(address): onlyOwner function adding an account to the reflection exclusion list.
KingBobo.includeAccount(address): onlyOwner function removing an account from the exclusion list.
KingBobo.balanceOf(address): returns token balance or derives it from reflection balance.
KingBobo.tokenFromReflection(uint256): converts reflection amount to token amount using the current rate.
KingBobo.setTaxless(address,bool): onlyOwner privileged setter for the taxless whitelist mapping.
KingBobo.setMaxTxAmount(uint256): onlyOwner privileged setter for the per-transfer limit.
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier enforcing _owner == _msgSender() on privileged functions.
Ownable._owner: privileged owner address controlling all onlyOwner logic.
_reflectionBalance mapping: per-account reflection (share) balances.
_tokenBalance mapping: raw token balances for excluded accounts.
_allowances mapping: ERC20 spender allowances.
_reflectionTotal: total reflections issued, mutated by fee/burn accounting.
_tokenTotal: total token supply, reduced by burn fees.
isTaxless mapping: whitelist of accounts exempt from transfer fees.
_isExcluded mapping: accounts tracked with raw token balances instead of reflections.
_excluded array: list of excluded accounts iterated by the reflection-rate computation.
_taxFee: percentage fee redistributed to all holders.
_liquidityFee: percentage fee routed to the contract for liquidity swapping.
_burnFee: percentage fee burned to the DEAD address.
isFeeActive toggle enabling fee collection inside _transfer.
inSwapAndLiquify reentrancy guard flag set by the lockTheSwap modifier.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled toggle gating the automatic swap inside _transfer.
maxTxAmount: maximum transfer amount enforced for non-privileged senders.
minTokensBeforeSwap: contract token balance threshold that triggers swapAndLiquify.
liquidityWallet: destination address that receives swapped ETH via transfer.
uniswapV2Router: trusted-by-assumption Uniswap V2 router used for swaps and liquidity.
uniswapV2Pair: token/WETH pair address, changeable by owner via setPair.
DEAD: burn address receiving reflection and token balances of burned fees.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller used for identity, taxless checks and allowance accounting.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value passed as the swap deadline to the Uniswap router.
payable(liquidityWallet).transfer(newBalance): ETH transfer executing after state updates inside swapAndLiquify.
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(...) external call with tokenAmount and block.timestamp deadline.
_transfer parameter sender: source address of the transfer.
_transfer parameter recipient: destination address of the transfer.
_transfer parameter amount: token amount being moved.
_transfer local rate: reflection conversion rate from _getReflectionRate().
_transfer local transferAmount: amount after fee deduction.
swapAndLiquify local contractTokenBalance: tokens swapped for ETH.
swapAndLiquify local newBalance: ETH gained from the swap and forwarded to liquidityWallet.
collectFee parameter account: account paying the fees.
collectFee parameter amount: gross amount subjected to fee deduction.
collectFee parameter rate: reflection rate applied to fee accounting.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender as the caller identity.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the owner-side address of the transfer.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender() to gate privileged functions.
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable for authorization.
excludeAccount is restricted by onlyOwner.
setTaxless is restricted by onlyOwner.
setMaxTxAmount is restricted by onlyOwner.
transfer delegates all logic to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the transfer to _transfer after allowance handling.
transferFrom reads and updates _allowances for the spender.
_transfer computes the reflection rate via _getReflectionRate.
_transfer calls collectFee when fees are active and accounts are not taxless.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify before finishing reflection balance settlement.
_transfer subtracts from and adds to _reflectionBalance for sender and recipient.
_transfer updates _tokenBalance for excluded accounts.
_transfer branches on _isExcluded for sender and recipient.
_transfer checks isTaxless for msg.sender and recipient before charging fees.
_transfer gates fee collection on isFeeActive.
_transfer checks the inSwapAndLiquify guard before triggering the swap.
_transfer checks swapAndLiquifyEnabled before triggering the swap.
_transfer enforces amount <= maxTxAmount for non-privileged senders.
_transfer compares contract token balance with minTokensBeforeSwap.
_transfer calls balanceOf(address(this)) to size the swap.
collectFee computes the tax fee from _taxFee.
collectFee computes the liquidity fee from _liquidityFee.
collectFee computes the burn fee from _burnFee.
collectFee reduces _reflectionTotal when tax or burn fees are taken.
collectFee subtracts the burn fee from _tokenTotal, sensitive to fee arithmetic.
collectFee credits _reflectionBalance of address(this) and DEAD.
collectFee adds the burn fee to the DEAD account reflection balance.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth to convert the accumulated tokens.
swapAndLiquify sends ETH with transfer to liquidityWallet, an external callback.
The ETH transfer target is the liquidityWallet state variable.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap operation.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, a miner-influenced parameter.
The swap is executed on the uniswapV2Router state variable.
_getReflectionRate reads _reflectionTotal when deriving the rate.
_getReflectionRate reads _tokenTotal when deriving the rate.
_getReflectionRate iterates the _excluded array to subtract excluded balances.
excludeAccount writes the _isExcluded flag for the account.
excludeAccount pushes the account onto the _excluded array.
includeAccount searches and pops entries from the _excluded array.
includeAccount clears the _isExcluded flag for the account.
setTaxless writes the privileged isTaxless whitelist mapping.
setMaxTxAmount writes the privileged maxTxAmount limit.
tokenFromReflection bounds-checks against _reflectionTotal.
tokenFromReflection obtains the current rate from _getReflectionRate.
balanceOf returns _tokenBalance for excluded accounts.
balanceOf reads _reflectionBalance for non-excluded accounts.
sender parameter drives the source side balance updates in _transfer.
recipient parameter drives the destination side balance updates in _transfer.
amount parameter seeds the transfer amount and limit comparisons.
local rate scales reflection debits and credits in _transfer.
local transferAmount is the post-fee amount credited to the recipient.
contractTokenBalance is the token amount handed to swapTokensForEth.
newBalance is the ETH value passed to the liquidityWallet transfer.
account parameter is the debited party in collectFee.
amount parameter is the gross amount fee percentages are applied to.
rate parameter scales the reflection accounting inside collectFee.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter is only meaningful inside the _transfer body and should be folded into that core function node.
The recipient parameter exists solely for the _transfer call and should be merged into the _transfer function node.
The amount parameter only flows through _transfer logic and should be absorbed into the _transfer node.
The rate local is derived and consumed entirely within _transfer and should merge into it.
The transferAmount local is intermediate state inside _transfer and should be merged into the _transfer node.
contractTokenBalance only exists inside swapAndLiquify and should merge into that core function node.
newBalance is the value paid out by the ETH transfer unsafe operation and should merge into it.
The account parameter is scoped to the collectFee routine and should merge into the collectFee node.
The amount parameter is scoped to fee computation in collectFee and should merge into that node.
The rate parameter only adjusts reflection accounting in collectFee and should merge into that node.
